verdict.rationale: A downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question for a SaaS research product like Gemini Notebook, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public API, an API spec, or any machine-readable interface description. The documentation covers only end-user features: sources, chat, notes, audio and video overviews, and public sharing. Exports to Docs/Sheets/PDF and crawlable help pages are not an API spec.
